entries.title: Watch and take over a task's browser from another computer
entries.body: A computer that controls your first mate now shows a task's browser too. Open it from a card or the task, take control, and what you click and type goes to the page on the computer where your first mate lives.

picture.alt: A task's browser shown on a second computer with control taken: a sign-up page under the row that says you have control, and Return control
